label: fix: Today
result:
I've fixed every high and medium finding and most of the quick low ones. But `test_flow` does not print "all good": it fails a server check that already failed before my changes. `server/checks/s3.py:200` asserts `got["accepted"] and got["sat_pace_ms"] == 95_000`, and it fails the same way on fa5e885, the preview commit before my merge. My merge changed only 5 web files (`index.html`, `ui.css`, `kit.js`, `question.js`, `charts.js`), so the failure isn't from these fixes. It is probably today's grid-in question having no other accepted answer forms, which makes `accepted` empty; I haven't confirmed that, and the server code is outside the branches I was given.

**Commits (not pushed):**
- `v2/s3`: 97c401e, 8d5ba32, 21c57f2 and one more (commit message: "on exam morning only the SAT card is held beside Up next"). All in `web/index.html`.
- `v2/calm-shared`: 8ac4eaa (`ui.css`, `kit.js`, `question.js`, `charts.js`).
- prev4 merged, now at d49702d. Server on 8075 from prev4 with `fix.db` is stopped.

**Walk:** 7 learners (new, mid, plan, final stretch, exam day, after the exam, goal met) at 1440 and 390, plus 1280 and 900, light and dark: no console errors and no horizontal scroll. I also drove the page in headless Chromium:
- Focus stays on the page on load, and J moves through card titles.
- Answering both day's questions: no orange pill, the ⋯ menu works, the streak went 0 → 1.
- On a same-day revisit the grid no longer moves.
- With `/api/today` failing there is one error box, and Due today no longer stays a skeleton.
- The focus-ring overlap check found no real overlaps left (the only hits are screen-reader-only chart tables).

**Page-wide**
- **Grid (visual, calm, states, convenience):** from 1080px the cards sit in bands, each with an 8-column main column and a 4-column side column. `#hero`, `#qotd` and `#tests` stay full width. The main columns hold Up next and Points, then Study time and the plan; the side cards go in one ordered stack and a measured split puts each where it leaves the least empty space. `#next{grid-row:span 2}` is gone. Below 1080 the DOM order is still the phone order. At 760–1079 short cards pair with short ones (Mistakes with Score, SAT with Pace). Cards only move when their place changes, so nothing loses focus or replays its fade.
    - Some empty space remains beside the plan card when the main cards are simply taller than all the side cards together (about 400–850px, in one block at the bottom).
- **Tab order (convenience):** from 1080px the DOM order now matches what's on screen.
- **Orange (all lenses):**
    - "Start today" is removed; each row's own Start does the same thing.
    - "Now its twin" is a normal button, so Up next's Study is the only orange on the page.
    - Disabled pills are grey instead of pale orange.
    - The skill goal tick is grey, and the time split has no orange segment.
    - The Study button is grey on a rest day.
- **Selected controls, not recoloured:** chosen options in segmented toggles and chips keep the site's orange edge from `ui.css`. Changing them on one page would make Today's controls differ from every other page.
- **Plan builder's selected days:** now use an ink ring rather than an orange one.
- **Mono (states, convenience, visual):** `.td .meta` and the eyebrow labels inside cards are Archivo. DM Mono stays on the real figures.
- **Card heads (visual, calm):** head() no longer adds `.k`, so every card title is the kit's 18px Archivo in ink. Due today uses the same card head as the others.
- **Quiet links (all four lenses):** on Today they have no negative margins and small padding, and rows have 14–16px column gaps. In shared `ui.css` the focus ring sits inside the link (-6px), segmented options and calendar days use -2px, and the picked calendar day is ink instead of orange.
- **Help paragraphs (visual, calm, states, convenience):** each became a small (i) that opens a popover, or moved into a tooltip, a menu or a fold. This covers mistakes, blind spots, rare skills, the score help, the challenge rules, the Points model note with its "How this works" link, and "How plans work". "Nothing to review yet" moved into the Mistakes (i).
- **Zeros and defaults (all):**
    - `nz()` now drops "0 of N" parts too.
    - Pace and Points drop the count while it is 0.
    - The checklist count only shows once something is ticked.
    - "goal met 0" is hidden, and "This week vs last" shows only once this week has answers.
    - Plan tiles show only when they have a value; the pager drops "0 of N · 0%".
    - The week strip has no "0q", and topic chips have no empty mastery bar.
    - "Nobody has finished" is removed.
- **Loading (states):**
    - The grid stays hidden until the skeleton paints, and the phone top bar keeps its height while it loads.
    - Skeleton shapes and titles are closer to the final cards, and the hero has a chips placeholder.
    - "Updating…" is positioned over the page, so it no longer pushes the grid.
    - The SAT dates repaint when the shell data arrives after `/api/today`.
- **Text sizes (visual):** help 13px, quiet links 14px, tags 12px, checklist 15px. The remaining odd sizes come from `ui.css` tokens.
- **Dark (visual, calm, convenience):** the ink tag and the wrong marks use `--mat` with ink text. Stack bars step down from a mid tone (shared). The chosen tab is paper with an orange edge.

**Hero**
- **Streak chip:** the flame and its number, centred, with "best N" in the tooltip. "No streak yet" is gone.
- **Minutes chip:** hidden at 0. It reads "N of G min today", or "N min today ✓" once over the goal.
- **Plan chip:** "Plan · N tasks today" until something is done.
- **Final stretch:** one chip, "SAT in N days · final stretch", with the slogan in its title.
- **After the exam:** no SAT chip; Up next leads with it.
- **Head shape:** "Add your name" moved under the head.
- **Brief:** on a phone each fact is its own line with no separator. The check-in fact is dropped when Due today has a Review row.
- **Greeting and name:** the greeting uses morning/afternoon/evening by the hour (4 AM is morning). It uses the first name only, clamped to 2 lines.
- **Not fixed:** "Since Sat: 16 of 15 min" comes from the server's brief text.

**Up next**
- **Buttons:** the Study button says just Study / Keep going / Practice anyway. The line under the chips says only the other half ("about N questions", or "~M min").
- **Pace:** both modes take one pace, the preview's when it has one, otherwise the learner's median.
- **Head:** it says only "Rest day" or "Test day"; on a plan practice day the size defaults to that day's minutes.
- **Controls:** More options moved to the Study row. The chips are `--ctl` tall and the 36px override is gone. Question counts are sorted.
- **Learn offer:** "See an example first", with the topic in its tooltip. The Diagnostic link is gone; it's in Score's menu.
- **Receipt:**
    - One figure line that breaks only between its parts; its class is renamed `rfig`, so the tile styling no longer leaks in.
    - Details opens Moved, Fixed and Points.
    - The points line itself opens the explanation, so the "How" button is gone, and the streak line is removed.
- **Exam morning:** the practice builder is folded behind "Or a practice session ›".
- **After the exam:** when scores aren't out yet, "Pick your next date" is the orange action.
- **Focus:** the questions no longer take focus on load (`autofocus:false`).

**Due today**
- **Head:** "about N min" beside the title, with the goal fit in its tooltip. "N parts" and "N of M" are gone, and the Plan sub shows "x of y done" only once x is above 0.
- **Rows:**
    - No "Build a plan" link.
    - The Review row meta drops "N due" and reads e.g. "2 check-ins · 25 fading · ~10 min".
    - A Sweep row says "Sweep" with its count underneath.
    - Each " · " part of a meta line stays whole.
- **Buttons:** the title and (i) stay on one line, with a 44px hit area and the reasons as its tooltip. The reasons open across the full row, and "1 times" reads "once". Start buttons are small, and a spacer keeps them aligned when a row has no ⋯.
- **Checkboxes:** plan task rings are checkboxes (with Undo).
- **Error card:** included now.
- **Exam morning:** the rows are folded.

**Mistakes**
- **Row class:** `.mrow` instead of `.trow`, so the global `.trow` from `plan-ui.js` no longer applies.
- **Empty state:** one line with an (i); the Practice link is gone.
- **Start review:** hidden when Due today has a Review row.
- **Meta:** "N fixed today · N new", with the rest in its tooltip; the "open" label is lowercase Archivo.
- **Spacing:** fixed.
- **Rows:** a chevron beside each label, one quiet line, then actions at one size ("Learn it again" as a quiet link, Try one now as a small button).
- **Folding:** three rows are open and the rest are folded; the rare skills are folded too.
- **Fix buttons:** "Fix these N · q" and "Fix the rare N · q", and the footer Fix all only shows without groups. The duplicate "+N more" link is removed.

**Questions of the day**
- **Head:** the title has a date only for a past day. The streak has its own calendar-tick mark, with the month and crowd in its tooltip and popover.
- **Labels:** the subject shows once, only when there are two subjects. Slots say only their format, and the label is hidden under 1080. The in-question "Grid-in" tag is off via a new shared `fmt:false` option.
- **Layout:** the two slots are top-aligned.
- **After answering:**
    - The buttons are Now its twin and 5 more like this, plus a ⋯ with Harder, Save, Share and Report.
    - "You're the first today".
    - The streak refreshes after both answers.
    - A restored verdict doesn't replay its fade.
- **Past days:** no visible label. Older is a tile, the strip starts at the learner's first day and ends on today, and empty days are faded.
- **Shared, in `question.js`:** in review the answer boxes show only for an unanswered question, and the verdict's trap line is dropped when the option already shows it.
- **Not fixed:**
    - The equation that breaks at 390: the stem is plain text.
    - The "Why each wrong answer is wrong" toggle: it's the control that hides the reasons, so removing it would remove a feature.

**Points on the table**
- **Detail text:** the `[object Object]` detail is formatted.
- **Folding:** Top 6 (3 on a phone) are open. "The other N" and "Not measured yet · N skills" are folds, remembered on the device, and on the exam day and the eve the whole list is folded.
- **Unmeasured rows:** Measure · 5 as the button and Learn as a quiet link with a tooltip.
- **Row layout:** the skill icon is centred with its name. The last column is 150px wide and the accuracy line doesn't wrap.
- **Head:** only the sort row is sticky. The head meta is "from N answers", and the model note is an (i).
- **New student:** one line and a quiet "Start the coach's set".
- **Shared, in `kit.js`:** no empty tiers, "under 5" is a small note instead of the headline, and the "rough" badge has the count in its tooltip.

**Pace:** "Shows after 20 timed answers", with the count only above 0; Timed set stays. The module button uses the shared label.

**Score**
- **No sitting:** "≈ 540, your estimate", or a plain "No score yet" line. One "Get a score" menu (Module / Diagnostic / Add a score), each explained.
- **Hidden until useful:**
    - The scale shows only when something is on it.
    - Where points went needs 5+ misses; a single cause is just the sentence.
    - "Not enough to project" waits for a first sitting.
- **Evidence and sentence:** evidence is "Thin in N domains" beside Sharpen, with the counts in the tooltip. The sentence no longer repeats the count.
- **Shared, in `charts.js`:** the stack bar legend only lists parts too narrow for their label.

**SAT**
- **No date:** the date buttons are a 2×2 grid.
- **After the exam:** the date, when scores come, and Remind me; the two actions are only in Up next.
- **Exam day:** "Today · Doors close 8:00 AM".
- **Checklist:** a fold under the summary, open from the eve, with 2 columns from 760px. The count appears once something is ticked, and the night-before group shows only on the eve.
- **Details:** no plan-line repeat, and the register row says only the days left to register. The countdown boxes show only in the last 7 days.

**Study time**
- **Tiles:** zero tiles are hidden, This week is hidden while it equals Today, and each tile has one short fact with the detail in its tooltip. "Active days" is shortened and the tiles are top-aligned.
- **New student:** one line and "Show the calendar".
- **Calendar:** the month stretches to its card (up to 640px) and the metric toggle stays on one line on a phone. Rest marks only from the plan's start.
- **Day detail:** for today the caption drops the tile facts, and a planned day shows even before any work. One time when first and last are the same minute. Mistakes are marked ○ opened / ✓ closed, with ×2 for repeats, and the plan status is in words.
- **Week and footer:** "This week vs last" is written in words. The footer drops the streak.

**Plan**
- **Head:** Open plan plus a ⋯ with Change plan and Add to calendar.
- **Day 1:** one line, "Day 1 of 42 · N study days · needs +19 a week", with tiles only once they have values.
- **Pager:** no arrows when there is one week.
- **Theme line:** skill names instead of slugs, in Archivo.
- **Week strip:**
    - Work ahead and Make up stay inside their tiles, as icons on a phone.
    - Day words fit whole ("Study").
    - No "0q", and Work ahead only on study or test days.
- **Next test:** shown only when it's outside the week on screen.
- **Builder:**
    - The second CTA block is gone; the step links and bullets are in "How plans work", and Adjust… is in the head.
    - Selects are 40px and the best guess value shows once the slider moves.
    - The help line sits under the button, and the date never defaults to today or a past date.
    - On exam day and after, the builder is folded behind "Plan for your next SAT".
- **Labels:** one Module and one Diagnostic label everywhere.

**Challenge:** the head reads "10 questions · 16 min" with the rules in an (i). The button reads Resume with the progress beside it, or "See your result" once everything is answered.

**Words:** minutes rounded up, and Start is hidden while Due today has a Words row.

**Tests:** the empty state is "No tests yet" plus a quiet Section link; Module and Add a score live in Score's menu.

**Low findings skipped:**
- The Points rows' "Not started" during an insights error: changing the shared `skillRow` default would affect other pages.
- The hover-only goal tooltip on Due today has no tap equivalent on phones.
